title: Slovakian Beef Casserole
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired beef casserole made with tender beef, rich sauce, and dense bread.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped Slovakian and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked beef mixture, cubed bread, shredded casserole, chopped nutty, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
